notes.title: New Virus Strains & Anomalies
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/d86960b03bfa48c4cd1f4ba6e59d4066cfb4aa99.jpg
In Deflector it's always an evolutionary arms race between you and your bioshells, and the hostile envrionments. What new twisted threats can you look forward to post update? Let's find out!

New Virus Strains
Virus strains represent an additional injection of difficulty into the already familiar environments. Whenever you play Virus Strains, you choose how many there will be. But as to what they will do? That is up to chance. And now there are several new ways that Virus Strains can turn out: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/6ff755bab5fed9a6398cc6b592752114e24eacd3.gif

 Mixed virus: This area may contain enemies from all the areas. Maybe those Flipbugs got lost.
 Overgrown viruses: Powerful enemies may now appear in Cell Extraction rooms. Don't get too relaxed!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/75cf39d6effc1019f7edc520d2115ed7e731b0d8.gif

 Fragile bullets: Most bullets may break when deflecting them. But they'll still hurt if you don't!
 Vengeful virus: Some enemies may shoot a bullet at you on death. Best be ready for these little final gifts.

New Anomalies
Certain rooms on your playthrough may be affected by anomalies, and there are now several more that you can come across while exploring!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/8fd6e55cfb7a4c14df863f3cb9303a2554e3b801.gif

 Lights off: Reduces vision.
 Rockets: From time to time, rockets will appear and chase you.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/ef4f4a1aa6dfc48bcc1aefa126644e3ed9809285.gif

 Poisonous ground: Poison puddles appear around the room from time to time.
 Larvae swarm: Enemies spawn a Larvae when they die.


We hope you are excited to experience all that the update has to offer! Do you have favorite anomalies and virus strains? Perhaps ones you just love to hate? Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: Deflector's Summer major update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/34b710f5afd8f5f22d8bd9e513de64df0e0bec82.png

Greetings, Specimens! You may have witnessed the full release of Deflector, but we did tell you updates were still going to happen! And it's time for a big one.

This scorching Summer update brings with it multiple ways to become stronger both for you, and for your dire foes. We'll cover them in great detail further down the line, but for now let's dive right in with the broad strokes.

[previewyoutube=RUrGrfSKUng;full][/previewyoutube]

New evolutions for each bio-shell
Whether you just can't stop bouncing boomerangs as the Eradicator or bully viruses with Lightfist's punches - every bio-shell in the game is getting a brand new evolution! Unlocking them however isn't as simple as looking the Deflector AI straight in the eye(s) and saying "Pretty please". You'll have to complete a challenge to unlock each of them. 

New virus strains
Since you've been doing so well against the existing virus strains it's time to add some new ones to the mix. With a total of four, you'll find them doing interesting things to the bullets you're used to deflecting and the enemies you're used to seeing in a given biome. 

New anomalies
Rockets and larvae and poison puddles - oh my!

New languages added to the game
Deflector is now available in Traditional Chinese and Japanese!

Balance tweaks to Lightfist's Multiple Strike Evolution
Now breaking 6 marks instead of 3 and having twice the range!

We are far from done with Deflector and you can expect more updates further down the line. In the meantime - have fun in the petri dish!

notes.title: Survival Competition - Crowning the winners!
notes.content:
Greetings, lab assistants! The Deflector Survival Competition has reached its conclusion, but what a path it was! You didn't stop struggling for an instant, every week showing us new outstanding results. As we promised, today marks the end of the contest, which means we're going to take one last look at our leaderboard and name the three winners who will be receiving a prize!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/f1066b7838eed7f74f343485b8d96f7d5749712f.png


 Raiser made an appearance as our number 2 on the scoreboard early on, but very nearly risked vanishing throughout the following weeks. Reemerging like a Giant Centipede burrowing out of the ground, Raiser now stands among our final winners in third place!
 Emerging from the very last week and jumping high from the get go is J_G112! A real burst of a performance that propelled them all the way to second place on our leaderboard! Fantastic work and sincere congratulations!
 ZombiZ first made themselves known during the very first week! They set a record that became the first one to get to the top, but was eventually outmatched. Not to be discouraged, ZombiZ kept coming back every week until they reached a score more than 20 times greater than their original! It's this juggernaut of a score that we're celebrating today as our winner in the first place!

We are amazed by the interest and eager participation all of you showed in the Survival Competition and we celebrate both our winners and all those who ended up on our leaderboards! 

To the three winners listed above: 
[olist]
 Please leave a comment to this article;
 Expect a friend request from a Steam Account named SuperGoodGames!com; 
 We will need you to accept the friend request in order to be able to proceed with sending you your prize.
[/olist]
That's the end of the Survival Competition! Who knows what awaits us in the future. Have fun with Deflector in the meantime!

notes.title: Bioshells - Unlock them all!
notes.content:
Since Deflector's release we've been seeing more of you ask how to unlock new bioshells for your use. That is understandable! And that is why we're publishing this guide. Let's go down the list of bioshells and clarify how each one can be unlocked for your use. 


Name: Eradicator
Unlock condition: Begin the Deflector experiment

Eradicator is your initial bioshell. His boomerang is open to every new participant in the Deflector experiment!


Name: Slasher
Unlock condition: Learn enough about Deflector

Slasher is a short-range combat specialist. The Deflector AI will unlock access to him automatically as you are learning about the experiment. Just keep setting out on your runs and you will eventually be introduced to bioshell selection and given Slasher as a sampler. 


Name: Gunslinger
Unlock condition: Defeat any Apex Virus 10 times

Gunslinger is a bioshell that lets you focus on long range. To unlock him, you need only defeat any Apex Virus 10 times. Every Apex Virus you beat counts towards that goal, so you can strike at different worlds in order, or just go on repeat runs against the one you have mastered beating consistently.


Name: Lightfist
Unlock condition: Defeat a Great Virus and an Apex Virus in the same run without using your regular attack

Lightfist is a bioshell named after her trademark weapon and unlocking her tests your ability to deflect and mastery over alternative sources of damage. Remember the condition only applies to Great Viruses and Apex Viruses, so you don't have to forgo your regular attack for the entire run - only the midboss and final boss of any one world. Still, the challenge is tricky. Remember to buff your Deflect attribute to make deflected projectiles more damaging and pay attention to your mutations. There are those that activate in response to dashing or deflecting, making them handy in clearing this challenge. You're allowed to use the active skill of your bioshell as well, so long as it doesn't require use of your regular attack.


Name: Spark
Unlock condition: Help the robot find the lost bioshell

Spark is lost at the start of the game. It will take solving a puzzle to bring her back and make her available for your use. Not to give the whole puzzle away, but start by going into Living Entrails and checking behind the waterfall of blood in the very first area you are taken to. From there you'll need to travel to different biomes until you've finally collected all the clues!


Name: Corrupted
Unlock condition: Defeat the Source

Corrupted is locked away behind the Source. Defeating it is the one condition to unlocking this bioshell. Of course that means you will need to survive all the way to the final boss and then beat it, so don't expect an easy prize. 



That's it for the bioshells unlockable in Deflector! Which ones have you unlocked already? Which ones have given you trouble? Let us know and enjoy the game!

notes.title: The full release update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=oRjK8_DmImE;full][/previewyoutube]
The wait is over and the Deflector experiment is now fully operational. To those of you who have been with us through Early Access - thank you. And to those of you who are first discovering the game - welcome. Both of you can read on to see all the juiciest and most enticing additions to Deflector. 

Six Bioshells

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/4ff8688e9ccfeb0be5c0fc29fa962929b3558795.gif

In the full version of Deflector, unlock up to six different bioshells, each with a unique set of weapons, abilities and ways to Deflect projectiles. The Corrupted, the newest bioshell to join Deflector, is an unusual one to say the least, and it’s only by overcoming the new two-stage incarnation of the final boss that you can get him!

Survival Chamber

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/51807df9c291f60d468c5fdd4ef2958d0fde4862.gif

A new mode of play perfect for those with a competitive streak! Defend the Hub from approaching bombs while being relentlessly assaulted by viruses both big and small. This mode of play is unlocked by playing Deflector.

Survival Chamber also comes with a global leaderboard, showing your results against every eager participant of the experiment out there! We plan to make use of that leaderboard very soon, so keep an eye out for an announcement.

Virus Strains

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/849a2a4806a70d7eaa2f965e0b34f0e5cbdcfcca.gif

In this new end game mode, you get to build your own difficulty! Choose to inject each biome with up to five Virus Strains, each resulting in an additional random debuff. This mode is not only a way to keep you on your toes even when you’ve mastered all that the path to the final boss can offer! It’s also tied to the new Proficiency system. 

With Proficiency, each bioshell now has a list of five permanent buffs, unlockable through Virus Strains. Feeling particularly confident about your Eradicator boomerang game? Want to show you can really shine as Spark? Challenge the Virus Strains with your favorite bioshells and grow stronger with each level of Virus Strain you have beaten.

Moving forward

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/317dcd83a49ff3b780bace195c6c9f0804c9cf8c.gif

Although Deflector is now available in its fully released version, that doesn’t mean work on it is finished for good. We will continue to work hard to balance, update, and keep Deflector a great game to play. You can look below for a full list of changes and tweaks. In the meantime - have a wonderful time in the petri dish, Specimens!

Patch notes

New

 New bioshell, Corrupted, added to the game with 5 unique bioshell mutations
 New final world map added
 Final boss now has a second stage
 New end game mechanic: “Virus strains”
 Proficiency level added to every bioshell
 New outfit added for every bioshell
 New game mode: “Survival Chamber” with leaderboards
 New enemy type: Champions
 Character selection screen and UI updated
 KarlOS now displays Evolutions at the Collector’s Laboratory
 Dialogue UI updated and new dialogues have been added
 New sound for UI and dialogues
 New room types added (Blood extraction and Nest)
 DNA upgrades fully reworked
 Added save slots to the game
 New music track added to Hollow Hive Apex Virus fight

Changes

 Active ability no longer charges from deflecting, but from damaging enemies with your main weapon or deflected projectiles.
 Bioshell unlock challenges updated for Spark and Lightfist
 DNA is now received at the end of every room rather than drop from enemies
 Damage numbers now change color based on type of damage. Enemy health bars are also adjusted based on max health and type of enemy

Balance


 Hub healing station base health reduced (30⏩25)

Bioshells
Slasher

 Radial Slash (Deflection) only consumes Rage if it hits an enemy

Gunslinger

 Deflect damage increased (30⏩50)

Lightfist

 Invisible obstacles (like room edges) now count as obstacles for the purpose of inflicting collision damage to enemies you push
 Breaking mark damage increased (40⏩50)
 Base damage increased  (65⏩80)
 Active skill hit damage increased (160⏩180)

Spark

 Active ability DPS increased (400⏩450)


Nucleoli

 Jetpack: Now adds 10% increase to your Attack and Deflect damage as long as it's active.
 Protective Pond: Now heals you every second while you remain inside it.
 Lightning Storm: No longer strikes randomly, but instead targets a certain amount of nearby enemies. The higher the tier, the more bolts will strike.


Neutral Mutations

 Guided projectiles: Number of projectiles increased (6⏩10) and projectile increment per tier increased (1⏩4)
 Projectile storm: Base damage increased (80⏩120) and cooldown reduced (3⏩2)
 Electrical storm: Base damage increased (90⏩170), gap time between required kills increased. (3s⏩4s)
 Impale: Base damage increased (30⏩50)
 Death mark: Base damage increased (80⏩100), marked enemies cap increased (4⏩8)
 Blossom: Cooldown reduced (5s⏩3s), and damage increment per tier increased (15⏩30)
 Hunter’s call: Damage increment per tier increased (4>6)
 Deflect burst: Base damage increased (120⏩150), and now marks appear over time, but there can only be on at a time.
 Deflecting turret: Base deflects required for activation reduced (8>6) deflects required decrement per tier reduced (2⏩1)
 Repulsive wave: Base damage increased (100⏩120), range increased (5⏩8) and rage increment per tier increased (1⏩4)
 Bubbles: Base chance of deflecting a bullet increased (10%⏩12%) ,and chance per tier increased (10%⏩15%)
 Charged disc: Charge time reduced (4s⏩3s) and base damage increased (120⏩150)
 Explosive metabolism: Base damage reduced (300⏩250) and range reduced (8⏩7)
 Survival armor: Now activates when close to an Apex or Great virus as well.
 Protective deflect: No longer resets when dashing.
 Speedrunner: Speed increment increased (20%⏩30%), duration increment per tier increased (1s⏩2s)
 Clean zone: Base duration increased (3s⏩4s), and size increment per deflect increased (10⏩12)
 Portable medkit: No longer disables after visiting a Safe Point.


Evolutions

 Linked boomerang (Eradicator): Base damage increased (70⏩90)
 Explosive boomerang (Eradicator): Deflections required reduced (3⏩2)
 Powerful spin (Slasher): Base damage increased (100⏩200)
 Explosive bolts (Gunslinger): Bullets now explode as long as you have no dash charges left.
 Area shot (Gunslinger): Base damage increased (30⏩40)
 Multiple strike (Lightfist): Has been reworked. New effect: “Marking an enemy marks other nearby enemies, and each time you break a mark, it also breaks the mark of up to X other enemies.”
 Skillful orbs (Spark): Has been reworked. New effect: ”Increase speed of Extended Orbit and reduce damage taken while using it.”

Bug fixes

 Resolved an issue causing Spinning Dash to release more boomerangs than intended.
 Resolved an issue causing a visual error with the Triple Sword evolution.

notes.title: Update 0.8.1 - New Tricks
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone! 
Our previous update has brought along some major changes (some of which we also examined in greater detail in subsequent articles). And what does Deflector do in response to change? It adapts! So today we would like to announce our next update and the bag of new trick it comes with. 

What’s more, the Winter Sale is on, so read until the end to find out about the bargain we have in store for you on the freshly updated Deflector!

Let’s kick off with changes to the Specimens. Some have more and some have fewer but they’ll all have an effect:

Slasher

 Slasher’s attacks now have increased range;
 Slasher now generates Rage when dealing damage to enemies with his basic attack;
 When Rage is available, Slasher’s Deflect ability consumes it, becoming wider and dealing more damage based on the amount of Rage consumed; 
 Slasher throws a sword by holding down and releasing Deflect. This consumes Rage. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7246f3d6da2129cbeb42ef9bc31630a584e2b353.gif
Gunslinger

 Gunslinger no longer has infinite range and his shots gain some spread;
 Gunslinger’s Deflect ability now creates a deflecting screen that you can hold, drastically lowering your movement speed while you defend yourself;
 Gunslinger’s active ability can now spawn up to 3 turrets by pressing the active ability button again within the first 5 seconds.

Spark

 Spark’s active ability now fires a beam of light that deals damage and pierces through enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/d26c9b6020969d0f1f860ecd720c9a45627623f7.gif
Lightfist

 Lightfist now marks enemies by hitting them with deflected projectiles; 
 Hitting marked enemies with Lightfist’s punches breaks the marks and inflicts additional damage; 
 Lightfist’s Deflect now pushes enemies. If this causes the enemy to collide with an object, it takes significant damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/a4bb5b69a4493e6a3da1b899b52848a345955ed7.gif

Your foes aren’t without some changes either! The following Great and Apex Viruses have been updated: 

Great Viruses

 The Serpent’s wave attack has been reworked; 
 Obelisk’s attacks have been improved. The fight should be more dynamic now!

Apex Virus

 Horned Giant has made some renovations to its arena, changing its shape;
 Horned Giant had an overhaul to its attacks, with some being removed; 
 Horned Giant now summons two walls in the second phase of the fight. They will shoot lines of projectiles periodically 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/06078cc9887ee8c90dff05b1299c78b9f55ecf2d.gif

While those are some of the changes easy to put a Specimen or Virus’ nametag to, there’s also a slew of other improvements to the game! Here’s a list of more general changes you’ll find in the game following this update:

That’s it for the update! 

What’s more, you can pick up Deflector with all its most up-to-date features at a 25% discount! Deflector is part of the Winter Sale and is available at this special festive price from Dec 22, 2022 - Jan 5, 2023 10am Pacific. Don’t miss it!

Bonus effects have been updated.

notes.title: Know your maps!
notes.content:
Have you been enjoying the new update? Between the new enemies, the switch to DNA Table and complete map overhaul, even some of the old became a lot newer. To help your participation in the Deflector experiment remain smooth, we’ve decided to detail certain new aspects. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/87031777ded9875aabd8be95786bb9d6180b1979.gif

Today let's take a look at the map and some new room markers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/9bf7d4cdf5c6f9e28ec335b60cbfa555709275fc.png

Progress in the Deflector Experiment has allowed for more consistent rewards as you clear rooms of viruses. A reminder in the top right of the screen while you’re exploring any of the four worlds will help keep track of all the icons. But what do they mean? 

Mutation Source
Clearing a Mutation Source room is what is going to help you acquire new mutations to make yourself stronger and add new abilities!

Growth
Survive a Growth room and you will be able to upgrade one of your Attributes. Remember, among other things Attributes affect the scaling of your mutations.

Cell Extraction
Exterminate the enemies and you will receive an amount of Cells. They’ll come in handy when visiting the…

Cell Exchange
This is one of the rooms that will let you take a breather. This is where you will be able to turn in the Cells you have earned and acquire upgrades!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/af76e70b1a33d0dad2a388884693d1aeb45b491b.gif

Safe Point
Another sight for sore eyes - a room where you will be able to restore your health and take a break from foes and projectiles. Not for long however. And certainly not with the remaining three room types.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/64cd5270b90699c04a8e5f26c879b51f5f97cb0d.gif

Survival
Chock full of enemies and traps. Your goal is to survive for a limited time and move on!

Great Virus
You’ll always find one in the middle of the map. The Great Virus is a ruthless midboss barring your way to the ultimate challenge of a given biome. Beat one and Evolve with a specimen-unique upgrade!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/75abb7cfd098d426370d16c5cf3f3aeeced4e866.gif

Apex Virus
As before, the pinnacle of a world’s challenges is the massive Apex Virus. The last room on every map. But will it be the last room on your journey…?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/ba1df3eef3e905a193053e143a5a4f6a20c7ad49.gif

Now you know what every room marker on a map means! We hope you find them helpful and don't get lost!

Deflector, Discounts & Decor!
Patch note 0.7.4.4
Lightfist Update is live!
Tips & Tricks #2
notes.content:
We hope you liked our previous Tips & Tricks drop, because we’ve got a new one for you! 

1. Enemies only get aggroed at a certain range. Clear only those you have already engaged to manage a smaller number of enemies, or roam the arena fast to group your enemies together!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/c4ed9ee6308b096432921ed486f15b2a143b7821.gif

2. Blood ponds and rivers in Living Entrails will slow you down! You won’t drown from stepping into them, but unless you have a dash ready you might end up too slow to dodge incoming projectiles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/22d29bc5a3954d4b04413876035fa06206795f89.gif

3. The poison in Toxic Sea does not damage you until the poison bar is completely filled. The bar also empties over time. Dipping your toe in the poison to dodge certain attacks (especially when fighting the Tentacles) won’t immediately damage you. Just be careful not to spend too much time exposed to it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/24f371bf2beb914fb725545b90912256087d3aa7.gif

4. When you have a choice between deflecting or dashing to defend yourself, always go for deflection. Ending up without a dash at the crucial moment all but guarantees you’ll take damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/f75e1f0ea6968741e02c06378b2c1b90f317e020.gif

5. Large spike bullets always split into several smaller bullets when they collide with anything, even with other enemies. Watch out for where they impact so you can be ready to deal with each projectile!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/aafa5e54d32b1a696931365779776595699361c8.gif

As always, we’d love to hear what sorts of tactics you’ve come up with while playing Deflector. Share away in the comments!

notes.title: 🛠 Hivestorm update is out today!
notes.content:
The wait is over! The Hivestorm update is out today! We think it’s a good time to recap all that there is to see in the new world and beyond it. 

[previewyoutube=PLPiNrgR0t4;full][/previewyoutube]

Travel into the Hollow Hive

The Hollow Hive is the fourth world in Deflector. A world of soil and the skittering sound of insect legs. The virus here clearly took inspiration from some creepy crawlies, and they’re coming for you as you intrude on their violent domain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/4301a65be7c39d7a4c859100bbe4daad67e84fff.png

At the top of the food-chain here are the Giant Centipedes. This deadly trio will keep you on your toes not just with projectiles, but with rapid burrowing and reemerging from the ground. Stay on the move. There’s little room to wait patiently for the shots to reach you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/ddbeff677db88623243a79c2790efe203cc21f56.png

If you can overcome the Giant Centipedes, you’ll be rewarded with one of two powerful mutations tied to your active ability. 


 Rock Skin surrounds you with a shell of stone, making you invincible for a short period of time.
 Inner Roots releases a wide cobweb that roots all enemies affected.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/e741190ad3cbfc2396214e632c7db3a88d5664f1.png

We know you probably can’t wait to challenge the Hollow Hive, but let’s not forget the other three worlds. Living Entrails, Toxic Sea and Magnetic Fields all got new locations to explore. So revisit them, especially if you’ve yet to best the Apex Viruses at the end of them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/500c372fa625d56b90a92f96fbe2b9d960c4faa1.png

Remember, after each defeated Apex Virus your subsequent runs will get harder. You only need to beat three Apexes to face the Core, so choose your path wisely!

Along with new content, this update also brings some improvements: 

 Updated Hunter UI
 Updated Mutation Shop UI
 Better homing on deflected projectiles
 Increased base healing amount when resting at a Safe Point
 Reduced Gunslinger turret duration
 Fixed bug causing interaction messages not properly disappearing after exiting to the menu

We’re excited to bring you this update and are looking forward to your feedback. Have fun and stay in touch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/d517573fcc475186e261ab718d2060886f8aca12.png

notes.title: Deflector's Massive Update!
notes.content:
The release of Specimen One introduced a new system that we’re finally ready to present to everyone! 
There are several key changes that we want to highlight.

Hub Progression 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/a63af255a250d4e188a24d1fa65cc313fb79179a.png

We’ve remade the hub progression, only leaving fun and meaningful upgrades that would make your runs more interesting. Because of such a massive change we’re going to refund all the points for the previous upgrades with some adjustments due to the size of the upgrade table.

Run Progression

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7eaf56cc2bb6b6073e13d8ab00dab2e2e4661d7e.jpg

The progression on the game map was streamlined due to the changes in the reward drops. We wanted to make sure that players always have a choice and would try more challenging maps for a better chance of reward.

Mutation Table

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7cca850f39a72505a45e98ca9fbc36930029767f.png

When changing mutation table we wanted to make sure that our puzzle-like DNA progression will make the run progression fun and meaningful. 

You will be using three things during your run progression:

Mutations
Mutations are your awesome skills that change your gameplay depending on what you pick. Decoys, explosions, giant boomerangs and more.

Strands
These blank hexagonal connections will help you reach different traits and give you more freedom of choosing where to go.

Traits
Previously known as alterations, these were remade as Traits that grant different effects. They exist to help you fine-tune your build during the run. To activate the traits you need to place Mutation or Strand near it and then it will open more alterations around it! Duplicate Traits improve the overall effects.


Roguelite progression inside roguelite!

Reward Drops

The entire drop system was overhauled to better fit the systems higher. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/e09863b6109a1e560e6f1da7e85c61a2a988d585.png

Cells
This is the currency you can use in shops.

DNA
This is used to upgrade everything in the Hub.

Virus Samples
This is used to open new droppable Mutations.

Additionally rooms can drop blanks (with certain upgrades affecting the rate) and in rare cases mutations.

The most important - you can now quit the game during the run and return from where you’ve ended.

So that’s it! Have fun in Deflector and don’t forget to leave your feedback about the new systems!


Here is the full patchnote:

New features

New DNA unlocks

 Almost all DNA unlocks have been re-done in order to be more useful during the game. Cost has been balanced so it does not take really long to unlock them.

New Traits (previously alterations)
 Traits have been re-done in order to grant effects that allows you to fine-tune your build.
 The more duplicate Traits you activate the more powerful they become.

Strands added as a rewards
 Strands act as a blank mutation, as they can be placed in the DNA table in order to reach other traits, but do not have any other effect.

New DNA table system
 New DNA table, together with the new reward system, allows for more customization based on the traits selected. Which lets you create different build styles based on how you place everything inside it.
 Table now always starts with four random initial traits. And when a trait is activated, two new traits appear close to that one (three with the upgrade).

New map progression
 Map scheme has been remade in order to make the player’s choice more meaningful. 
 Paths now will have several nodes in a row, so choosing your path will play a bigger role now.

New drop and reward system
 Reward system has been completely re-done in order to avoid choosing between “short-term fun” and “long-term efficiency” and increasing “reward vs risk” decisions.
 Only mutations are now shown on the map.
 Cells drop in all rooms. Quantity increased in harder arenas.
 DNA now has a chance to be dropped when killing enemies. Chance increased in harder arenas.
 Virus samples always drop in elite rooms and after defeating a world boss.
 Mutations now drop in a random arena in one of the paths. Usually they appear on the more challenging routes. 
 Strands drop randomly in any combat room where a mutation is not dropped. Chance increases with the challenges attached to the arenas.
 Health orbs no longer drops but you can get more health through traits. We may add certain other ways to drop health later.
 A shop now can always be found in quest rooms.
 Dispenser added to shops. Dispenser allows you to buy unlimited amount of strands.

Added new nodes on the map:

notes.title: First community event starts now!
notes.content:
Hello, our precious assistants!

We've just released Specimen One with the new progression and reward system, where players are actively reliving the early days of the Deflector Experiment and seeing how Specimen 2e+777 fared against the first huge breach of the virus.

It is said that Generation II got their name, Slasher, exactly from that breach. Why? Because 2e+777 eliminated a tremendous amount of viruses during that test leaving a huge pile in the quarantined zone. 

But how many he got there? That's where we need you to find out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/da17f6880f4906d01cebb43e9eb44d93f4ed2f50.png

Now every kill counts. Go into Specimen One and show them the power of the Slasher in the first community event where all the user's scores* in the Last Stand will be counted towards the milestones to open global rewards for everyone in Deflector!

The event will continue for around a week and when it's done it's straight to the new update on Deflector!

* - The overall score will be available in-game at later date. Probably tomorrow

notes.title: Hotfix - Deflector Ver. 0.69c
notes.content:
This is a small hotfix before the implementation of the new progression and reward system.


 German language added.

notes.title: The world of Deflector Experiment is expanding!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/44af9e7d8312255f881d4c3bae399fce1d8ccaac.png

Hello, our trusty assistants!

Steam Next Fest is coming up and Deflector celebrates the occasion by introducing Deflector: Specimen One!
[previewyoutube=vPOJ9DzyqM8;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825340

Following Specimen Zero, you now get to face off against the virus with Slasher, a second-generation sample that evolved towards a more aggressive paradigm favouring close combat.

Not only is Deflector: Specimen One going to introduce a new way to fight - but also a new way to mutate and progress. We are introducing changes to the current progression system, reward drops and more in Specimen One and will be closely monitoring your feedback. We want you to have the best possible experience and will introduce the new system into the main game in an update soon after Deflector: Specimen One.

Hop in now to prepare for our first Community Event that we will announce tomorrow, get that new and slick skin* for Slasher and eliminate those viruses!

Click Demo to play Specimen One, the product will evolve on release.

We'll be waiting for your feedback on Steam Discussions or Discord. 

* - The costume will be available with the next update for the main game which will roughly happen in two weeks.

notes.title: Hotfix - Deflector Ver. 0.69
notes.content:
Hello assistants, it's time to fine-tune the experiments!

Improvements

 Gunslinger's turret now deflects properly.
 Magnetic Fields boss' room collisions are more consistent now.
 Mole enemy has been temporarily removed from the game.
 Eradicator's boomerang catch distance was slightly reduced to improve boomerang deflect accuracy.
 Hub options are now navigatable with a Dpad.
 New font added for the Russian language.
 Fixed collisions in Living Entrails and Magnetic Fields arenas.
 Settings values are now applied from the moment the game is opened.
 Blob enemy now jumps at you when attacking.
 DefleKT enemies no longer shield nearby allies, instead they create a static shield dome.
 Volt enemies now shoot three bullets.
 Added confirmation window when exiting or giving up the run.
 Overall improves to the attacks of the final bosses of all the worlds.
 Health bard for all enemies now displays in white the amount of damage dealt.


Bugs

 Solved an issue where dashing was sometimes not consuming a dash charge.
 Slasher’s second challenge now unlocks the correct variation.
 Solved an issue when mutation “Energy Wave” was not dealing damage.
 Solved an issue where enemy tracking arrows were getting stuck.
 Mind field bombs no longer spawn above the character.
 Solved an issue where sometimes you could get perma poisoned while over the boat in Treasure Island mission. 
 Vsync now works properly.
 Virus sample picks up now displays description and name correctly.
 Solved issue where you could get stuck on the death screen after defeating an enemy just after you died.
 Solved an issue where the Reset Keys button was not working properly in the settings menu.
 Specimen skill list title now displays correctly in Specimen selection screen.
 Esc button now works properly during the pause in the Hub menu.
 Solved an issue where completing one world would count for two in certain challenges.
 Solved an issue with Toxic tentacles doing the same attack several times in a row.


And that's it! Next on the list is an update coming for the main game, Specimen Zero and finally Specimen One!

Expect some interesting changes to the progression, mutations and more!

notes.title: Community Update #1 - "The world of Deflector and Specimen One"
notes.content:
Hello, our precious assistants.

February is upon us which means we're working hard on the upcoming update to the Deflector, Specimen Zero and the release of Specimen One.

Specimen One will focus on Slasher and begins slowly building the lore for the world of Deflector which of course will reflect in the main game and Specimen Zero. All players who will play through Specimen One will be able to get a unique skin for him as you did with Eradicator.

And we want you guys to decide which skin it will be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/eb6514c4738061ab1ec6f45ce0f75d789d2bf6a5.jpg

You can vote here by saying choosing (1) Left or (2) Right! The same voting is going in our Twitter and Discord, so use whatever medium is most comfortable for you.

Also, we've heard your feedback so expect a lot of QoL changes in the upcoming update by the end of February and some hotfixes next week.

notes.title: Deflector Experiment Roadmap
notes.content:
Good day to all experiment assistants!

We're very thrilled with the current response to the Deflector release and we're actively collecting feedback to fine-tune everything in the game in the upcoming patches.

Speaking of upcoming things - we're ready to present you with our roadmap for a year* worth of Deflector content!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/15ff0bf7bd56a5ec2c4dafa64d7659dedd265b12.jpg

This roadmap not only represents our commitment to make the game as good as possible throughout the year but also to prepare you for a lot of activities related to the Deflector world!

You're already familiar with Specimen Zero, it's our short free experience about Eradicator in his prototype form, which you can earn and use for your playthrough in Deflector!

However, doesn't it seem strange that Eradicator looked like that back then? What is the Deflector experiment? Well, if you're curious, then keep a close eye on the games (Yes, including Specimen Experiences), upcoming Specimen One and our socials. 

While the main experiment is going (Early Access) and grows in size we want to start introducing everyone to the world of Deflector - in what way and form that is going to be done? We'll find out later.

I'm certain you're also curious what will be in our updates for the Deflector Early Access and here are the things you can expect for sure:

 More Specimens
 More Mutations
 More Enemies
 More Worlds
 More Arenas
 More Quests 
 More life and variety in the existing worlds
 And of course - more challenge


We can't wait to share more with you so keep a close eye on our Discord, Steam News and other socials.

*We aim for a year worth of content but time frames can shorten or extend, we'll keep updating the roadmap after certain periods of time to keep it fresh.

notes.title: Hotfix- Deflector Ver. 0.68d
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're hoping you're enjoying your time in Deflector and we're glad that you are sending us your feedback, ideas and bug reports.

Bugs Squashed:

 Solved an issue where players get stuck in the settings menu right after launching the game and clicking settings before the menu appears.
 Solved an issue where Prototype costume was not available after completing Specimen Zero.
 Ground collider fixed in the Jailer room.


Fixes:

 Eradicator's Alpha boomerang return speed reduced
 Eradicator's Alpha amount of deflects to reach maximum range are reduced by one.
 Healing Stream in Hub base healing adjusted ( 10hp → 30hp)
 Bridges in Magnetic Fields world now glow to be more visible


Localization: 

 Text for the button “Move Down” is fixed.


Don't forget to report any findings in our Discord or Steam Discussions. 

We've also updated the FAQ with several questions:

Is there a story in the game?
Yes, it's hidden in the world and interactions and will be developing through other means besides the game as well.

Are there any tips for the quests and opening characters?
The game itself is made to be challenging whereas variations of the characters can be opened by looking at the Specimens and their respective challenges in the main menu. However, to open characters, to fully complete quest lines and open more content players need to learn more about the world and explore it.

How many characters are currently in the game?
Four characters with three variations each, which makes it around twelve different playstyles available to players in the game.
